Yoga for seniors is not about flexibility or performing advanced asanas. A regular, appropriately adapted practice can help maintain strength, balance, mobility, coordination and independence as we age.
JOIN OUR 3-MONTH TTC COURSE
An immersive 3-month on-campus program for serious Yoga practitioners and teachers who wish to deepen their practice, understand traditional Yoga, and develop the expertise to teach at an advanced level.
